description: Everything a reviewed public page declares, in one call and one fetch: title, meta and Open Graph, canonical, robots directive, JSON-LD with its schema.org types, resolved links with an external count, tables, content fingerprints, and readable Markdown. Replaces six separate extraction calls, and adds the cross-checks none of them can make alone — a canonical that disagrees with the URL you asked for, a page declaring noindex, missing structured data. Pay 50000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

include_markdown.description: Set false to omit the Markdown body and keep the response small. Defaults to true.

url.description: HTTPS URL on a reviewed public origin. Permitted origins: https://docs.python.org, https://developer.mozilla.org, https://en.wikipedia.org, https://www.cisa.gov, https://www.sec.gov, https://home.treasury.gov, https://books.toscrape.com. robots.txt is honoured and redirects are refused.

findings.description: Named observations that need comparing several extractions to notice.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the raw HTML and of the visible text, with sizes, for change detection.

links.description: Resolved links with total and off-host counts.

replaces_calls.description: How many single-purpose extraction calls this one replaces.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

structured_data.description: Parsed JSON-LD blocks, a count, and the distinct schema.org types found.

tables.description: HTML tables as rows and cells, with a count.
